reading_evidence: Read all eight source blocks and both complete targets: dreams not stagnant because not clutched; soul learnt ancient art; repeated why relationship departure; days silent smile; soul revolts/turns hundred times to explain; imagined love or fleeting emotion recognized fallacy; flawed truth cannot sustain orbiting flowing love; ah do not heed soul, red wine/friendship until part again. Preserved dream/soul distinction, ironic withdrawal of the critique, hundred count, wine and isolated final again.
open_questions: Soul turning a hundred times and love-versus-fleeting-emotion alternatives retained without assigning motive or relationship biography.
reason: Recast one inverted phrase into natural Odia syntactic order and breath; preserve three-line stanza and complete meaning.
tradeoff: Preserve full source experience and existing accurate wording; target cadence adjustments do not settle source questions. Self-review only, independent fluent/author review pending.

prior_uncertainties.note: Preserves dream/soul distinction, critique of imagined love, wine and temporary friendship, with terminal again on its own line. Hindi feminine speaker is provisional; source does not explicitly mark gender.
